item.title: How Tranditional Nasvay is Made in Kyrgyzstan
item.description: Traditional nasvay production in Kyrgyzstan offers a closer look at a smokeless tobacco product with deep roots in Central Asia. Its preparation, ingredients and manufacturing conditions raise important questions about product quality, toxicant exposure and consumer safety. The latest GSTHR video explores how nasvay is made, highlighting why understanding traditional nicotine products is essential to developing effective, evidence-based tobacco harm reduction strategies. (Published on October 15, 2026byyoutube.com)

item.title: Tobacco Risk Management: An Opportunity for Health Plans to Accelerate the Decline of Cigarette Smoking
item.description: Health insurers could play a much greater role in reducing smoking-related disease in the United States. Despite smoking cessation being among the most cost-effective medical interventions, fewer than half of smokers report receiving advice or assistance to quit. (Published on October 15, 2026bysubstack.com)

item.title: Tale Of Two Nations – Vol. 15: Kazakhstan v Sweden
item.description: Sweden and Kazakhstan illustrate how different tobacco control strategies can shape smoking trends and public health outcomes. Sweden has made significant progress in reducing smoking prevalence, supported by the availability of safer nicotine alternatives. Kazakhstan, meanwhile, has pursued a more restrictive approach to nicotine products, raising questions about the impact of limited access to smoke-free options. (Published on October 15, 2026bysmokefreesweden.org)
